title: The square of an even integer is even
prose:
Theorem. Let n be an even integer. Then n squared is even.

Proof. Since n is even, there exists an integer k such that n = 2k. Then n squared equals (2k) squared, which equals 4k squared, which equals 2 times (2k squared). Since 2k squared is an integer, n squared is twice an integer, hence even.
